newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street's open seen mixed to a bit lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street's open seen mixed to a bit lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open Monday mixed to slightly lower amid profit-taking after last week's jump in the Dow industrials.
Analysts said markets were likely to focus on earnings in the absence of economic data.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 1/32 to yield 7.05 and the S&P 500 futures index was up 0.15 at 770.40.
"After last week's rip-roaring performance, we may just see a little bit of profit-taking here," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
